news.title: Steve Hilton’s ‘Just Try It’ Ad on Mail Voting Denounced by Republicans
news.summary: An online spot for Mr. Hilton, the G.O.P. candidate, is full of sexual innuendo that has befuddled Republicans and Democrats watching the race for governor in California.
